cycles.rationale: All three binding-ruling breaches removed; the four naturalness stumbles the reader named on the merits fixed without any fact added, dropped or softened. Remaining deductions: the 'sorun' homograph on the floating button (kept, see reader item 1), the Kare collision in the chip (closed ruling, inherent), the 'Bulbul' spelling stumble (binding brand), and the KVKK register of the notice's second sentence (correct for its function).

blind_reader_rulings.reason: (a) 'sorun' as noun 'problem': the dative 'Bulbul'a' governs a verb, so the noun reading is ungrammatical and is cleared within the word group; 'X'a sorun' is the stock Turkish formula ('Eczacınıza sorun'). The reader's 'Bulbul'a sor' is the sen form, banned by config.address_form and UI1-controls; 'Bulbul'a danışın' runs to 16 characters against the role's ≤14 pill target, and 'Bulbul'a soru sorun' to 19. (b) 'Bulbul' vs 'bülbül': binding termbase entry 'Bulbul' (Latin brand, not 'Bülbül' = nightingale, entry arapbülbülü); not reopened on a reader remark alone; adding what Bulbul is would add a fact the button does not carry (the bird icon carries it).

Brand 'Visit Al-Ahsa' stays Latin (P2, binding, og:site_name in every language); 'El-Ahsa' is the place name, the Latin brand is the site's name, so the two spellings are a brand-vs-name distinction, not an inconsistency. 'Visit Al-Ahsa danışmanı' already answers 'whose advisor'; 'El-Ahsa gezi danışmanı' drops the brand and adds 'gezi' (ar 'مستشار زوروا الأحساء'). 'danışman' = 'مستشار', not bureaucratic. Same as de judge-r1 #2.

Applied: 'gezinmeye' → 'dolaşmaya' (also binding UI1-gezinmek) and the shorter chain 'yalnızca buralıların bildiği yerlerin peşinde misiniz' (E4). Rejected: the 'Ben Bulbul' name stumble (binding termbase brand); emoji are binding (brief); 'her hurma ağacını tanırım' the reader itself passed ('hoş … sorun değil'), kept as the source's palm image.
blind_reader_rulings.new_wording: Şöyle bir dolaşmaya mı geldiniz, yoksa yalnızca buralıların bildiği yerlerin peşinde misiniz? Nelerden hoşlandığınızı söyleyin, keyfinize göre bir gezi ayarlayayım.

blind_reader_rulings.new_wording: Cebel el-Kare ne zaman açık, giriş ücreti ne kadar?

'dinleniyor' is the source's persona line ('بلبل يستريح الآن' / 'Bulbul is resting'); spelling out 'service unavailable' would replace the owner's voice with a fact the line does not state. 'Gezinizi planlayın' is the exact published nav.plan label, binding by the brief and BL1-features (page named by its label); 'Gezini planla' is sen. 'Gezilecek yerlere … göz atın' is the published plan.empty.browse phrasing for the attractions pages.

'Bulbul' spelling: binding termbase brand (not reopened on taste; already raised to the owner by the emergency batch). Al-Ahsa/El-Ahsa: brand vs place name (P2); 'Cebel el-Kare' lower-case article inside a compound is P1, not an inconsistency.

raised_by_stage4_rulings.reason: Stock Turkish hosting welcome, the closest register to the hearty Gulf 'يا هلا والله!'; one '!', siz, no fact. The blind reader called it 'doğal ve sıcak'. Bare 'Hoş geldiniz!' is flatter than the Arabic.

Keeps the palm image of 'نخلة نخلة' / 'palm by palm' (de judge r1 #3 and r2 #4 kept the literal image for the same reason); 'karış karış bilirim' would erase it. Reader read it as playful hyperbole, 'sorun değil'.

'تُحفظ' / 'stored' = retained; 'saklanmaz' is that sense exactly. 'kaydedilmez' (not recorded) would claim the questions are never written down at all, stronger than the source. No published tr legal text mentions the advisor, so there is no wording to align with.
